question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: ETERNAL
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Infinite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Eternal"** means something that lasts forever, without an end or beginning. (अनंत, शाश्वत)

 
 
• **Example:** Love for family is often considered eternal and unconditional.
 

 
• **"Infinite"** refers to something limitless or endless in extent or size, impossible to measure or calculate. (अनंत, असीमित)

 
 
• **Example:** The universe is said to be infinite in size and full of mysteries.
